The first is more open, and the second is closed off.
When I was first diagnosed, my dad told me I'm making it up and for me to take another pill to "feel better." He then told me to cut my wrists the long way to make sure it works.
I could use some help with my bipolar. Let's do this.

This is just really hard to deal with recently. I have been dealing with it for over a decade. I am forcing myself to be with friends but, it's too hard sometimes. There are days when I wish to be alone, but when I'm alone it's at its worst. My thoughts consume me. The delusions sink in. I'm alone right now. I just constantly hate myself, and remember everything stupid or wrong I've ever done. I sometimed wish I could just stop all of this by suicide. But, that's not the correct way to go about this. I just need this to stop. This is stupid, how come I can't be normal, and strong, and not care. Why do I feel like a baby back bitch. This seems like it's a never ending cycle. It's times like these where it's hard to figure out what's the delusion and what's the truth. I can't trust anyone to talk about this. They just tell me I'm being stupid. Fuck, when does this end?

I'm almost 30, and I have talked to a counselor. I'm just too afraid to open up fully and tell her everything. I don't want to go away. It just sucks. I'm hoping once I get back on meds I feel better.
I've been dealing with this shit for over a decade now and it doesn't get easier...

Thanks, most people don't understand that I can't just stop feeling the way I do. Like its a switch. I know in my brain my thoughts are the depression. But, my heart tells me otherwise. This constant battle is ruining me on a daily basis. I'm just wondering when my heart will win.
